mock_response.reasoning: Matches this vendor's default account exactly.

note: Added alongside the amount-outlier check (accounting_agent.py / invoice_classification.check_amount_outlier). Everything about this suggestion is actually CORRECT per ground truth -- the account matches, confidence is high, no hallucination -- but the amount (8500) is wildly outside this vendor's normal 90-115 range, so it's still flagged for review. Demonstrates the new check catching a real, different failure mode than EVAL-010's: a vendor whose account is right but whose amount is a genuine anomaly, which is arguably the more common real-world case (a compromised or erroneous invoice reusing a known vendor's identity).
